## Bookmark Manager

A full web app in `/work` — Node/Express backend with a persistent JSON store and a clean single-page frontend.

**Features**
- **Add / edit / delete** bookmarks (URL, title, description, tags)
- URLs auto-normalized (`example.com` → `https://example.com`)
- **Tags** — comma-separated, with clickable filter chips
- **Live search** across title, URL, description, and tags
- Data persists to `data/bookmarks.json`

**Structure**
- `server.js` — Express REST API (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/bookmarks`), listens on `0.0.0.0:4000`
- `public/index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.js` — the UI (dark theme, responsive)
- `.harness/app.json` — configured so the review container launches it via `npm start` at `http://maker:4000`

I verified the server starts, the API round-trips (created and read back a test bookmark), and the page serves with HTTP 200, then cleared the test data.

To run it yourself:
```bash
cd /work && npm start
```
then open `http://maker:4000`.
